summary: Parry deflect active window (ticks 6..12) was unreachable when Guard evaluated on button-down at tick 0 against Bell Sentinel overhead strike.
root_cause_hypothesis: Input handler bound both Parry and Guard to the same button-down tick without state-machine priority disambiguation.
proposed_repair: Evaluate Parry immediately on button-down (startup ticks 0..4, active deflect window ticks 6..12) and transition to continuous Guard only if the input remains held at tick 13 without a deflect trigger.
